label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Vess Vollol
english: V.2 · The Night of the Naming

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Desir ul et syst pawast.
english: *Late in the second summer.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hethym et greller vess ull, eth re hadhom sy lo et odh ul hedh et ryst. Solant et crynireth sa wrodhom umont ul et nelter vimm sost tul; orr hos dem vimm amm maver, eth cadh hos o yarl umont.
english: *I held the lamp that night, and laid this at the hearth on the evening after. The planks I tell of lie yet in the lowest vault, and whoso will may go down and lay a hand on them.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et grem hosast ull, re dhyvull et vorr sy um et wemmeth myst. Re vysk Kael: Re naelurant et kethow navenn; eth re dhyvullom hosen et ullen.
english: All that first winter this fire laughed at the grey sails. "They have picked the wrong fortress," said Kael, and I laughed with the rest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vess desir ul Hyll Pawast, re orra Halyna dem vimm, dem et nelter hemm sost ul vimm et hellur sy, ul vodh re yal et ternil wesket. Re fennym sona, eth et luth eth et grellereth lom. Doss o brid ul et syst hosen ul et grem. Re solant et trenneth, myst um vyst, hosen trunow kylet sa re hebb tolmath.
english: One night late in the Second Tide, {{Halyna}} went down to the oldest room under this hall, where the Rite was found. I came behind with the ink and the lamps. As cold it is in summer as in winter. The rows lay grey on grey, like a field the plough hath turned up stony.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal lo ull pa vurr eth sullnoth crynir et grem hosast, eth gor hos rytet. Re lymment et haskardath so dem varn, pa haskard lo hos crynir, hy ul vodh re hebb et wadh so, eth et tant ul vidhyl um so sestyarlath. Re yal et ullen lo vorrath et hesperdeth, eth lo et hyll. Re voll et hald so: et flenneleth. Ew hosel crynireth so.
english: Fifty-three planks of the first winter lay there, and every one carved. The runners had carried them home two to a plank, from wherever the sea gave them up, the salt running down their arms. The soldiers' fires had the rest, and the tide. The wall called them the tablets. They were but planks.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor hos hyont veth hos, re hebb o hos brod lo Halyna; eth re rytym et brodath, hos brod lo flenn. Re hebb et hos nayalat, veth re yal o rytet gell hosen gor hos. Dyndeth ul sestow et hosast re lymm et wadh o.
english: Each but one had given {{Halyna}} one word, and each word I wrote on a leaf of its own. That one had given naught, though it was carved as finely as any. The sea brought it in weeks after the first.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymment crynireth Hyll Pawast pa rellor gor hos, rytet virr, hosen rytent vollath virr um hosk hemm. Um et dhysal re rystulla Halyna kethyl vana olen, eth re yal tresk ul et brodhol gor fedh. Nath re hlennym so lo haevereth. Dem vess ull, re orr nahos dem vimm dem bessyl et pa vurr eth sullnoth: ho ross mest?
english: The planks of the Second Tide bare two signs apiece, cut close, as names are cut close on an old lintel. On the shingle {{Halyna}} learned to hold two at once, and there were gaps in every telling. I have not mended them with guesses. Till that night no one had gone down to ask the fifty-three for more.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew nasell et vess, eth ew sell et trenneth; hy ull re hadha et tolm hosast ul et pa rask, Rhyna lo et bystir eth Halvard lo et hald deld. Re veskym Halyna nafedh ul gethyl hy ullen, dem vess ull. Eth nath re yala deld hy ullen: sellyth et nelter.
english: The night was short and the rows were long, so they began at the two ends, Rhyna at the stair and Halvard at the far wall. Never ere then had I seen them work apart. They were not far apart: the length of the vault.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rik Rhyna et crynir hosast sost, et fodh sa re vysk orrow, eth hos cless sell treskat lo. Re rik Halvard et hos nawrodh, eth re yal cless sell treskat lo, hosen lo et hosast.
english: Rhyna took up the first plank of all, the wave that had said *shore*, with its one long edge split raw. Halvard took up the silent one, and its long edge was raw also.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re stonom ul lodh Halyna, eth et greller lom. Nath mellor helvhoss dem et gunn sy, eth re dhald et vem venn ul en narl.
english: I stood between them with the lamp. No wind cometh so far below, and the flame stood up straight in mine hand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wemm Rhyna ey crynir. Lo et hald deld re wemm Halvard o hrynir. Hosen sy taldant et bysketeth deld olen eth et bysketeth virr, hy vodh el hos piskur tunn o.
english: Rhyna lifted her plank. At the far wall Halvard lifted his. So rise the far knots of a net with the near, for it is all one net.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hos clemel re hyle et pa lern.
english: Their two faces changed in the same moment.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re wrodh Rhyna, eth new brod o. Ew haral tunn o.
english: Then Rhyna spake, and it was not a word. It was a whole order.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Dem morrow. Hosen meskrivull dem nynth, orr. Nath dovv um yend.
english: *To shore. As root to water, go. Wait on no bough.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et dask deld, eth et crynir nawrodh lo, re vysk Halvard o olen, brod um wrod.
english: From the far end, with the silent plank in his hands, Halvard said it with her, word for word.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re wrodh gor hrynir. Re hadhar so ul drenn, hosen re hebb et wadh so; eth vess ull re hebb gor hos o dhrenn sost. Et vess tunn re orra Halyna lo dhrenn et trenneth, Rhyna dem Halvard eth Halvard dem Rhyna; eth re orrom ul lodh, eth re rytym. Ul molt et trenneth re yal grest um en narl dem et brellir, eth nath re hessym. Dossant lo sy et ullen, hosen re rytym so:
english: After that every plank spake. In the order the sea gave them up we had laid them, and that night each gave up its own. All night {{Halyna}} went along the rows toward each other, and I went between and wrote. By the middle rows mine hand ached to the wrist, and I stopped not. Here are the others, as I wrote them:

label: Romanisation
rom: Cresk hald. Tolm hosast, tolm hosel. Drunn dem lunnol, ell dem tho vorrdhuss. Ew ull et gemmyorn tunn: hosen sy rytent so et galat nawrodh, tolm. Re runnant et scetheth ull hos hald dem felmyl, eth re vollar so: dend.
english: *Break wall. First stone, only stone. Strike till it opens or wood is ash.* That was the closed square, their sign for the mute thing, stone. Those hulls had struck one wall till they sank, and we called them mad.

label: Romanisation
rom: Orr dem drunn. Ul vodh tresk sast, kyl lo sest. Re hyl et hos ull, eth re fenn nahos o. Re vollar o: nawerd.
english: *Go until struck. Where bark splits, turn aside.* That one swerved, and none followed it. We called it a coward.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lern lymmerd, mesk bynt. Omm mesk bynt; ser lymmerd. Et scetheth lo wisk et trenn, re yal haralat lont: Senna hosast! Eth re sennent hosast.
english: *Before bearer, thin wood. Thin wood falls; bearer keeps pace.* Those at the head of the column were told to die first, and they died first.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vodh re rod o, drunn. Drod dasken, drod hosel. Et bramm sa re wrodh dasken, re hylent dem o. Re vollar o: maver.
english: *Where it flashed, strike. Last flash, only flash.* Whatever gun spake last, to that they bent. We called it hunger.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tovv ul myst, hosen fymmet ul frenn. Amm sol tolm, darr. Re vellorant amm re hesser veskyl.
english: *Wait in grey, as seed waits out frost. When stone is still, come.* They came when we had done with looking.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem varn, amm grestet. Omm hos gend; kyl gor hos ul o nynth sost. Lo vammol hosast re rigent, eth re rast et hald ul hylenn.
english: *Home when wounded. One bough falls; all turn, each by its own water.* At the first loss they scattered, and the wall cheered.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rikent et hesperdeth bisk et haral dem voll, hos eth hos, ul et brodath venn: Dem et orrow. Creska et hald. Tovva ul myst.
english: The soldiers took the head of each for its name, in plainer words: *To the shore. Break the wall. Wait in the grey.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re hemme Halyna ul molt, re yal myst et ryst ul morrol dem vimm um et bystir. Re sol hos crynir ullen lo rask et trenn dasken, hosel. Re lymm tolmard Dhavow Vorr o dem susk et brunn ul sestow et Ommol, vorrat domm lo hos dask. Nath re hydull o lymmyl nayalat hy o hinnar, eth nath re sesk o vodh ew o.
english: When {{Halyna}} met in the middle, the grey of morning was coming down the stair. One plank more lay at the end of the last row, by itself. A mason of Emberhythe had carried it up the mountain after the Fall, charred black at one end. He could not bear to bring naught of his city away, and what it was he wist not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hethe Halyna o lo rask, garl eth garl um et meskdhrenn, somm re stacornant et grellereth.
english: {{Halyna}} held it last, a hand of each on the grain, while the lamps went pale.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vysk o: Vorr.
english: It said *Burn*.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wrodh nahos, eth lo dhrenn fedh sell nath re rytym. Hy ull re hadh Halvard o ul o reskow, lo rask et trenn dasken, hosel.
english: No one spake, and for a long while I wrote not. Then Halvard laid it back at the end of the last row, by itself.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew ull gor yalat sa re heth et mesk tevel: hos brod lo sceth, eth ulo hos haral. Re vysk gor sceth o wrod lo ol hald, eth re vysk pawast, eth re vysk dem felmyl.
english: That was all the young wood knew: one word to a hull, and in it one order. Each hull said its word at our wall, and said it again, and said it till it drowned.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re naelurant galat.
english: They had not picked anything.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yalant luskat.
english: They had been sent.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re dhald et orl, re rikym et crynir hosast eth et hos nawrodh. Et vess tunn re vymment en veskowath dem so hless. Re hadhom so sest lo sest, cless treskat lo hless treskat.
english: At full light I took up the first plank and the silent one. All night mine eyes had gone back to their edges. I laid them side by side, raw edge to raw edge.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hemm et meskdhrenn cresket.
english: The broken grain met.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hemm o hosen cemme pa saed et mesk treskat. Nath re vessym Halyna vodh kaever o, eth nath re wrodha o lom.
english: It met as the halves of a split log meet. I have not asked {{Halyna}} what it meaneth, and they have not told me.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re resker ul molt et crynireth, ol sull. Re vorrant et grellereth tul, eth re hess nahos so. Lo rask re vyskym sy, eth re luska Halyna o ul stonol:
english: Then we three sat down among the planks. The lamps burned on, and no one put them out. At last I said this, and {{Halyna}} let it stand:

label: Romanisation
rom: Kaeverym: et scetheth ull, ew et mesk tevel sost so, luskat hosast, hy vodh tev et tevel pynt sost. Et dath sost hy et mesk, nath re vellor o tul. Doss o ul devyl tul.
english: "I think those hulls were the youngest of the wood, sent first, for the young grow quickest. The worst of the wood is not behind us. It is still growing."

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Hylleth sa re nydh et Hald
english: V.5 · The Tides, as the Wall Counted Them

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Lo rask hyll eth hyll, lo dhrenn vran grem.
english: *At each Tide's end, for six winters.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Kael Nydherd, sa nath re hadh hyll veth amm re yal o tunn. Ul et grem vranast re haral o lom clennyl et vran, hosen re hlennym o dhrenn hosast; re lyssym en glennyl umont.
english: *Laid by Kael the Counter, that would tell no Tide till it was over. In the sixth winter he bade me mend all six, as I had mended his first; I have mended them less.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Nath reskym; es stonom.
english: Give me the stone. No, I will stand.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Hos · Hyll Pynt
english: **I · The Hasty Tide**

label: Romanisation
rom: Nydhym. El nydherd en.
english: I count. That is what I am for.

label: Romanisation
rom: Thell wemm et ryst hosast, eth re heth nahos reskow lo sest ullen. Re runn gor sceth et hald hosast sa re femm o, dem felmyl.
english: Eight sails the first morning, and not one kept station with another. Each struck the first wall it touched till it sank.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ston nahos um et pressireth. Hy et lymmscetheth re vellorant et uldath veskrivull, hosen syndalol vidhet. El meskeleth so lo et hald, hosen amm es lyss voll so.
english: No man stood on the decks. Off the transports the root-men came like spilled kindling. Treelings the wall called them, as if a name could make them small.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo sorenn re yal vorr et scethan ul lyssyl, eth re rystullar myskyl: Doss vorr et scethan vyssorat.
english: By noon their fire slackened, and we learned to say, "The fleet hath spent its fire."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re omm vathur um lern bithlernen et hald, hyvenn, hosen re vysk halflenneth et vestul domm; eth re hoss gor hos lo o sestow. Rytom um ull. Ston.
english: A breach on the south face fell outward, as the slates of the black chest said, and all behind it lived. I swear to that.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et grem ull re vyskym lo et vorr sy: Re naelurant et wemmeth myst et kethow navenn. Gor vess re orr o lo dhrenn et prentheth olen eth et nunth, eth re fimm gor uld dem o. Re dhyvullar. Haeril ol, Vardh: re dhyvullar.
english: All that winter I said at this fire that the grey sails had picked the wrong fortress. Every night it went round the benches with the cup, and every man drank to it. We laughed. God forgive us, we laughed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Yory Dhavow Hemm, sa re hossvell um et hald rerddhalden, re dhyvull o bont sost. Doss voll Yory hosast ul vimm et stelleth rerddhalden.
english: Jory of Eldhythe, that whistled on the east wall, laughed the loudest. His name is first under the east cairns.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rik vorrsceth o. Vess ull re dhresk et Crenn ryssyth yarl hy saed et covv sa hovv o, eth re wysk o o um hagess, um stell Yory.
english: A fire-ship took him. That night the Captain cut a hand's breadth from his half of the cloak, and bound it on a pike over his cairn.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew et saedel hosast o.
english: It was the first strip.

label: Romanisation · added in Seren’s hand
rom: Cadhat ul narl Seren: New et dasken o.
english: ***Added in Seren's hand:*** *It was not the last.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Pa · Hyll Pawast
english: **II · The Second Tide**

label: Romanisation
rom: Et nydhyl pawast, eth duss hy et hosast.
english: The second count, and a harder.

label: Romanisation
rom: Pa eth pa re vellorant. Et hos ul lern, re rik o et pedh; eth et hos ul sestow, re rik o et trun.
english: In pairs they came, the front to take the shot and the back the ground.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et pell bridlernen re rik sceth pedh. Bost lusul dem et bithlern, re stacorn wemm sceth ullen, myst eth lurrel dem sulv, hosen lern uld; eth re hyl o.
english: Off the north point a hull was struck. A mile south, another's sail went grey-green to white, like a man's face, and it turned.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re vesk o. Re heth o.
english: It had not seen. It had felt.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re vellorant et biskscetheth, eth et fymmet dhenthen, ul vodh re yalant et brammath lor velv.
english: Then came the crown-hulls, and their winged seed, to wherever our guns were quiet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re felmer movennerd, re rik ullen et movenn, eth re rik et scethan molt et movennerd clenn. Myskym o tul lo et brammardath tevel: Naelura et molt sa luskos lont.
english: When we sank a bearer, another took up the standard, and the fleet took on the new bearer's temper. To the young gunners I say it yet: choose which heart ye leave them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth Corlen Dhavow, hemm sost et Delv, nind thenth dem et helvhoss ul lern et kethyl, gor fedh. Re vysk o: Tovv. Nath dunn et wadh tul.
english: Corlen of the harbour, eldest of the Twelve, held a wet finger to the wind before every holding. "Wait," he would say. "The sea hath not finished."

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul mommol fymmet re vellor sceth niss um o dhrun. Lo o dhesset sost re heth o o wramman velv, dem mellorol et sceth virr. Re vesk Corlen um et nynth, eth um nayalat ul o sestow.
english: In a seed-fall a hull came slow on his water. By his own judgement he held his guns quiet, to let it close. He had eyes for the water, and for naught behind him.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellor et fymmet um et hald, ul vodh re yalant et brammath velv.
english: The seed came over the wall where the guns were quiet.

label: Romanisation
rom: O wrammath.
english: His were.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re senn o lo et hosk hald, ul veskyl et nynth, eth sull hy o wrammyarl olen. Vess ull re dhresk et Crenn et saedel pawast.
english: He died at the parapet, watching the water, and three of his crew with him. That night the Captain cut the second strip.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth Corlen hosen es geth et Crenn ul o reskow. El gor yalat vennuld ull. Eth re hurr ull o.
english: Corlen did what the Captain would have done. That is the whole of a True Man. It is also what killed him.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rik Voss o wramman, eth re dhald o vennuld. Lo et kethyl fennet re heth o nind thenth dem et helvhoss, hosen re heth Corlen. Re vesk et Crenn, lo o sest, dem susk, eth nel dem et wadh.
english: Voss took his battery, and was raised a True Man. At the next holding he wet a finger, as Corlen did. The Captain at his shoulder looked up, and not out to sea.

label: Romanisation
rom: Kyl tho vedh.
english: "Change your shot."

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sull · Hyll Dhumol
english: **III · The Tide of Remembering**

label: Romanisation
rom: Re seskys Wik. Re hask o hy reskow dem reskow, eth dem et odh sy sost, eth re resk o lo et lern ul vodh reskent et tevath, o yerd dem o wrodow. Re yal haskol et haldorrol lo, somm re vysk hos et Hosk pa fedh. Nath re vaver o veth haskol wrod dem et Crenn.
english: Ye knew Wick. He ran everywhere, even to this hearth, and sat at the front where the children sit, his knees to his chin. The wall-walk he could run in the time it took to say the Title twice. Naught he wanted, save to run a word to the Captain.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo vess re varr et Crenn et bramm bithlernen pa vurr lusul. Lo ryst myst re ston Wik lo reskow hemm et bramm, dem veskyl et nynth. Um et hald bridlernen re vorr greller Hesk tul.
english: By night the Captain had the south gun moved forty yards. At grey morning Wick stood at the old gun-place, to watch the water. On the north wall Hesk's lamp burned yet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellor hos sceth, hosel eth niss, ul nydhyl nynth. Nel dem et hald. Dem et reskow ul vodh re yal et bramm. Re wramm o lo ull, dem veskyl: ho dhess et bramm?
english: One hull came, alone and slow, sounding. Not to the wall. To the place where the gun had been. It fired there, to see whether it would answer.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rik et pedh et hosk hald, eth re omm Wik lo.
english: The shot took the parapet, and Wick fell with it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re veskym o. Re vesk Hale. Re hebb Wik sull brod lo.
english: I did not see it. Hale did. Wick gave him three words.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dossant ul veskyl.
english: "They are looking."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellor o wrod dem et Crenn, hosen re vaver o gor orl et gorrol.
english: His word came to the Captain, as he had wanted all the war.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hask Hale o.
english: Hale ran it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess ull re dhresk et Crenn saedel Wik. Hosen sy re senn rall hy wramm sa nath re yal lo ull.
english: That night the Captain cut Wick's strip. So a boy died of a gun that was not there.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re haeverer: el kynteth so, sa rystullant lo hulter. Veskent hosast, eth hy ull oskant. Re hethent ol haldath; ol Grenn, nafedh. Hy ull re varrar et brammath lo vess, eth ew gorrol velv hy ull, eth re vallom o lyss hy et gorrol bont.
english: We had thought them beasts, that learn by the stick. They look before they trust. Our walls they knew, and never once our Captain. After that we moved our guns by night, and it was a quieter war, and I liked it less.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Gemm · Hyll Lodhat
english: **IV · The Joined Tide**

label: Romanisation
rom: Et vess tunn re yalant et drunnatath ul drunnol ul myst, hy sceth dem sceth. Lo dhess re vellorant et wemmeth um sull orrol olen, bridlern eth rerddhald eth bithlern. Sull orrol, hos clem.
english: All the night before, the drums went in the grey, hull to hull. At first light the sails came on three roads at once, north and east and south. Three roads, one hour.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hossvell Lanner Gynten dem et helvhoss, hosen hossvellent uldath gynten. Re ston et Crenn lo o sest, eth re sol o. Re hess Lanner hossvellyl.
english: Lanner of the crags whistled for the wind, as crag-men do. The Captain stood at his shoulder, and was still. Lanner stopped whistling.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lusk.
english: "Loose."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos clem ul sestow et dhess, re felm bramman Lanner so vovennerd.
english: An hour after dawn Lanner's battery sank their bearer.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re omm et scethan. Ul et clem sa re ryt et molt sennet, re hylent um et orrol rerddhalden, ul nynth pondul: re stacorn hos wemm, eth hy ull et fennet, hos hoss ul lodh. Re hethent clem vrener sennet. Ew scetheth vovennerd sost hosel sa re hylent ul nend.
english: The fleet faltered not. At the hour the dead heart had carved, they turned in on the east road, into empty water, one sail pale and then the next, a breath apart. They kept a dead mind's hour. Only the bearer's own went wild.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lern et hedh re orrom lo dhrenn et hald dem nydhyl. Re weskym Enno Stonwrytan ul et vathur rerddhalden; eth bost lusul hyo, ul et bridlern, Della.
english: Ere dusk I walked the wall to count. Enno of the guild I found in the east breach, and a mile on, in the north, Della.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Lesk · Hyll sa re rystull nycul
english: **V · The Tide that Learned Deceit**

label: Romanisation
rom: Et nydhyl leskest, eth nath vallom o.
english: The fifth count, and I like it not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellorant hosen re vellor et mesk tevel, bont eth hosel eth venn; eth re dhyvullar hosen re dhyvullar ul et grem hosast. Re wrodh gor wramm, eth re vellorant et ganurardath dem et brammath sa re wrodhant, gor hos. Re luskant broclinth um orrol clenn gor orl, scetheth sa new scetheth; eth um et orrol ul vodh nath re yern bramm, et uldath veskrivull.
english: They came as the young wood came, loud and alone and straight, and we laughed as we laughed the first winter. Every gun spake, and the hunters came for every gun that had spoken. Straw they sent down a new road each day, hulls that were not hulls, and root-men down the road where no gun woke.

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth vesk virr, hosen re vysk Pellow. Re haemer broclinth susk, eth nath re lusk kaelir, eth nath re ferr lo vedh. Re heth hollarol navenn o dhrenneth, eth gendsceth sa re stacorn, new gendsceth o.
english: But look close, as Pellow said. Straw rode high, and left no wreck, and flinched not at a shell. A false rout kept its spacing, and a green hull that blanched was no green hull.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re veskent merr hyor, eth dossant ul vimm et stelleth rerddhalden.
english: Some of us looked not, and they are under the east cairns.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesk Pellow gor yalat ul o sirr, eth re dhyvullos umo, eth re dhyvullom en sost. Re rasor o ol sirreth veskyl deld, hy sirr o hinnar.
english: Pellow held his glass up to everything, and ye laughed at him, and so did I. Our far-glasses he ground, out of the glass of his city.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesk Pellow, eth doss o ul vimm et stelleth, hosen so.
english: Pellow looked, and he is under them too.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth veskyl nahos hossen. Re heth o et hald.
english: Looking kept no man alive. It kept the wall.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Vran · Hyll Dasken
english: **VI · The Last Tide**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et grem sy, amm re vamm scethan o vovennerd, eth et pawast, re orr o dem varn. New driget. Re orr.
english: This winter, when a fleet lost its bearer, and the second, it went home. Not scattered. Went.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul Hyll Lodhat re wrodha Halyna lom:
english: In the Joined Tide {{Halyna}} had told me:

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss carmol et scethan dem varn,
english: "The fleet cannot be called home,"

label: Romanisation
rom: hy vodh lynir et mesk et mesk.
english: "for the wood obeyeth the wood."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhessym lonta: Es luskar o dem varn; eth nath re seskym vodh re haeverym. Nath noss o harmol dem varn. Veth doss o luskol dem varn.
english: I answered that we would send it home, and wist not what I meant. It cannot be called home. But it can be sent home.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss ludalol lo et mesk.
english: The wood can fear.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo rask et grem sy re vellor noth sceth strom sa new scethan, eth re reskent ul ol gummath. Re voll et hald so: Crenneth Myst; eth et hesperdeth: Reskowath Strom. Reskent lo ull vess sy.
english: At this winter's end came ten great hulls that were not fleets, and sat down in our havens. The wall named them Mystarchs, and the soldiers the Thrones. They sit there tonight.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn vran grem re nydhym et wemmeth myst. Seskym et nydhet, eth nath gadhom o lo et odh sy.
english: Six winters have I told the grey sails. I know their number, and I will not tell it at this hearth.

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth es gadhom et nydhet lor.
english: But I will tell ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel nydhyl nydhyl dem vollol. Vess sy ul et parow re harmom vollath et vennuldath: gemmnoth voll, eth delv sa dhess.
english: A count is no count till it be named. Tonight in the ward I called the roll of the True Men: fourteen names, and twelve to answer.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re harmom Corlen Dhavow, re yal velv et parow. Re luskom o velv lo fedh hos hoss, eth re harmom et voll fennet. Amm re harmom Hesk Lynth, re vellor et tessyl dem vimm hy et hald bridlernen, ul vodh re yal o reller syndalat. Amm re harmom Pellow Vell, re yal velv et parow.
english: At Corlen of the harbour the ward was quiet. I let it be quiet the space of a breath, and called the next. At Hesk of the mere the answer came down from the north wall, where his lamp was lit. At Pellow of the spire the ward was quiet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy hunna sennetath et hald, eth ketha so, hy vodh dossant lor. Yory, sa re hossvell. Corlen, sa re dhovv um et wadh. Wik, sa re hask hy reskow dem reskow. Enno eth Della, Enrella, garl ul narl. Pellow, sa re vesk gor yalat ul o sirr. Re dhresk et Crenn ryssyth yarl lont, hos eth hos, hosen tresk et rirnan et blenth dasken, eth kethent et saed bynt sost.
english: Now hear the dead of the wall, and hold them, for they are ours. Jory, that whistled. Corlen, that waited on the sea. Wick, that ran everywhere. Enno and Della, {{Enrella}}, hand in hand. Pellow, that held his glass up to everything. For each of them the Captain hath cut a hand's breadth, as poor men cut the last loaf, their own share thinnest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Et stelleth rerddhalden ullen, re vollom so ul hedh ul molt et tolmath, gor voll, pa fedh. Lo et dasken hyont nath re ston en garm, eth nath nyculom umo.
english: The rest of the east cairns I named at dusk among the stones, every name, twice. My voice was not steady at the last of them, and I will not feign it was.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et grem hosast re haemer saed et covv sa hovv o dem o yerd.
english: His half of the cloak hung to his knees the first winter.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess sy nath mellor o dem o simm.
english: Tonight it cannot reach his belt.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss o ul reskyl lo ull amm sy, lo rask et prenth.
english: There he sitteth now, at the end of the bench.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
